svg.font-family: Nimbus Sans, Liberation Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: – a bidirectional SCAN replaces attention over tokens

g.text: the SPATIAL axis only – no path crosses between the two encoders
the image is 16 x 16 patches, flattened in raster order
the highlighted token is the one being updated
the same recurrence twice, in opposite directions, then merged
bidirectional because a raster order is arbitrary – token i+1 is not "later" than token i
